projects.title: Takue Microdrama Series
projects.logline: Vertical 9:16 Microdrama Studio • 40 Episodes • 5 Clips Each
projects.storyPrompt: A fast-paced dramatic sequence across 40 episodes with cliffhangers, confrontations, and cinematic visual pacing.
projects.masterPrompt: Shot in 9:16 vertical 4K resolution, mobile portrait framing. Shallow depth of field with 50mm and 85mm prime lenses, cinematic bokeh. Dynamic camera movements: subtle slow dolly-in, tension-building rack focus, dramatic eye-level close-ups. Volumetric atmospheric lighting, natural skin tones, professional color grading with rich shadows and highlight roll-off. Pacing is punchy, high emotional stakes, crisp audio clarity.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Episode 1 sequence: 5 sequential scenes encoded for 9:16 vertical drama.

clips.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic microdrama. High-angle slow push into a rain-slicked penthouse balcony overlooking a glowing metropolis. Anamorphic lens flare, Seedance photorealistic lighting.
Vertical 9:16 dramatic scene. Tense confrontation across an executive boardroom table. Shifting eye contact, volumetric fog, dramatic depth of field.
Vertical 9:16 high-stakes drama. Extreme close-up on emotional expression as classified documents hit the glass table. 8k hyper-detailed texture, dramatic shadow.
Vertical 9:16 action escalation. High velocity motion, emergency blue beacon lights pulsing across the room, electric tension.
Vertical 9:16 episode cliffhanger. Sudden shadow engulfs the frame as a secret seal is revealed under flickering lights. Shock freeze frame.
